ld.description: HOUSE OF PRIDE 2027 | edition #s6xBERLIN’S QUEEREST MAIN PARTYJuly 24, 2027.  Berlin Pride hits its peak — and House of Pride takes over after the Parade.For one unforgettable night our multi-venue Ritter Butzke, AQUAHŌFE Berlin & Kreuzwerk transform into a massive queer playground in the heart of Berlin: seven areas, indoor & outdoor, packed with beats, 50+ performers & djs, wild energy and thousands of people coming together to celebrate exactly who they are.House of Pride is not just another party. It’s a statement. A celebration. A beautiful, sweaty, loud and unapologetic explosion of queer culture. The event supports Berlin Pride and a beneficial project every year! From house to techno, disco to pop, RnB, rave & to everything in between, expect a genre-hopping journey through some of Berlin’s most iconic spaces — with 50+ artists, spectacular performances and enough energy to carry you through 12+ hours of Pride night.Come for the music. Stay for the madness. Dance with strangers. Kiss whoever you want. Lose yourself in the crowd.No labels. No limits. No judgment. Just Pride.HOUSE OF PRIDE 2027July 24, 2027 | 21:00  7 AREAS · INDOOR & OUTDOOR 50+ ARTISTS · 5 GENRES 3,500+ PEOPLE · 12+ HOURS KREUZBERG · BERLINThe official Main Party of Berlin Pride | CSD Berlin 2027.Headliner & Line-Up: TBAThis is your Pride night. Make it c(o)unt.
ld.name: House of Pride (HOP) Berlin | THE MAIN PARTY OF BERLIN PRIDE

ld.description: ist das kalt da draußen! Wäre es nicht viel schöner, sich jetzt in einen wohlig-warmen Kinosessel fallen zu lassen, und sich von warmen Wörtern, heißen Zeilen und kuscheligen Reimen unterhalten zu lassen? Der Ostberlin Poetry Slam versüßt euch die Wintertage, wie stets mit Poeten, Comedians und Erzählerinnen von nah und fern. Das ist ganz großes Kino! Also, der Alte Saal vom Union Kino eben. Mit Gedichten, Humor und Geschichten, die dein Herz so genug erwärmen, um dich durch den Winter zu bringen!
ld.name: Ostberlin Poetry Slam
